description.narrative: Nepal - Roads Project: The objective of the Road Maintenance Project (the "Road Maintenance Project") is to maintain road quality across Nepal's primary or strategic road network (the "SRN"). To achieve the Road Maintenance Project Objective, MCC Funding will support: (i) funding for technical assistance and capacity building to Nepal's DOR and RBN, and (ii) up to 305 kilometers of maintenance works on Nepal's SRN.
